summary: Timeboxed field-masked production inference snapshot for EU DPA audit validation
description:
Issue summary: Request for timeboxed, field-masked access to production inference responses and associated request metadata for a regulated EU customer's DPA validation. Impact: Customer audit requires sample outputs tied to request metadata (timestamps, model, route) but not full PII. Purpose: Compliance team needs to validate that redaction and minimization controls are effective.
Request details: Provide a scoped archive (CSV/JSONL) of up to 500 inference records over 7 days for region eu-west, including: request_id, timestamp, model, route, latency_ms, token_count, and the model output with email/address tokens replaced by <REDACTED_EMAIL> / <REDACTED_ADDRESS>. Exclude full request payloads; only include hashed request_fingerprint for linkage if needed.
Justification: External DPA audit scheduled; auditor requires deterministic sample to verify redaction rules. Two-person control requested, and keys must be wrapped with KMS. Access duration requested: 48 hours from approval.
Access controls & audit: All access must be provisioned via an ephemeral storage bucket with KMS encryption, ACL restricted to two named approvers, SRE must enable object access logs, and Security must run a sampling job to verify redaction before handoff.
Data minimization plan: Use existing redaction pipeline (redact-service v2) with additional tokenization check. Any records failing redaction must be excluded and logged for remediation; an exception report must be attached.
Risk notes: There is a small chance of sensitive tokens leaking if redaction rules miss patterns; mitigation includes manual review of 25 random records prior to release.
Deliverables: 1) Zipped archive in S3 with MD5 and KMS envelope; 2) Redaction verification report (25-sample review); 3) Audit trail (who/when) for bucket access.
SOP references: see related_confluence_pages above and runbook 'prod-data-extract-timebox' in the infra runbooks.
